gate.primaryEndpoint: paired fixed-model series Brier over the full committed reconstruction
gate.thresholdJustification: The retirement threshold is symmetric with the preregistered 0.005 challenger-promotion threshold: production is not demoted for a deficit too small to justify promoting a replacement.
gate.uncertaintyMethod: Paired season-clustered bootstrap with 10,000 deterministic resamples over matched series losses.
gate.differenceDirection: productionMinusComparatorBrier; positive values mean production is worse.

retirementRule.comparatorPolicy: Demote production to research-only if every required check passes against at least one named simple comparator on identical series.

requiredChecks.brierIntervalLowerBoundAboveZero: The paired season-clustered 95% interval for productionMinusComparatorBrier has lower bound > 0.
requiredChecks.comparatorLogLossNoWorse: comparator log loss <= production log loss on the same series.
requiredChecks.comparatorCalibrationSlopeNotFartherFrom: abs(comparator calibration slope - 1) <= abs(production calibration slope - 1) on the same series.

interpretation: Production met every preregistered retirement condition against at least one named simple comparator and should be demoted to research-only.
